steps.title: Business brief from public information
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: from jobs/{{job_id}}/brief and the business's PUBLIC pages only, write who the customers are, what they need from a {{business_type}} site, and the three actions the site must drive.

steps.title: Site PRD
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: write the PRD for the {{business_type}} site: pages, forms, backend (bookings/leads/payments as needed), data model, auth, and the 80% exit bar (backend complete).

steps.title: Design direction
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: propose the design direction (layout, type, colour, motion) that passes the vibe-engineering design bar for a {{business_type}}.

steps.title: Send the repo to the factory
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: queue {{repo}} on the factory intake (POST /v1/factory/intake, counts against the 5-a-day cap) with the PRD and design direction.

steps.title: Factory build to the PRD
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: the factory builds {{repo}} to its PRD in the sandbox (program/starnet-v2/06).

steps.title: Security district attack runs
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: two attack runs against the private preview (districts/security/CONTEXT.md); HIGH/CRITICAL blocks.

steps.title: Judge by a different model family
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: check the private preview against the PRD's exit bar and the design direction; report pass/fail per requirement.

steps.title: Share the preview with the client
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: share the client-visible preview link.

steps.title: Pricing, contact and go-live
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: price, contract and go-live are the captain's.
